enchantments.tooltip: +14 Enhancement Bonus: +14 enhancement bonus to Armor Class.
Quality Spell Resistance +10: +10 Quality bonus to Spell Resistance.
Resistance +10: Passive: +10 Resistance bonus to Fortitude, Reflex, and Will Saving Throws.

Quality Proof Against Poison +2: This item grants its wearer immunity to natural poisons. This item also grants a +2 Quality bonus to saving throws against magical poisons, and the wearer does not fail saving throws against them on a roll of a natural 1 (this renders the wearer immune to magical poisons with a DC of less than 3 + their Fortitude save).
Quality Spell Save +2: This item gives a +2 Quality bonus to your saves versus spells.
Mythic Armor Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Physical and Magical Resistance Ratings.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
